subject: [hw] V03 facts for FACTS.md: exact vendor relocation statistics + packed format order
body:
Facts from the V03 loader (host only; llvm-readelf 23.1.4 as oracle). Please add to FACTS.md.

[V] The five vendor objects contain exactly 3120 dynamic relocations that the loader must apply, per object:
  bin/vpud: 91 = 29 R_ARM_RELATIVE + 5 R_ARM_GLOB_DAT + 57 R_ARM_JUMP_SLOT (.rel.dyn plain REL 34 entries, .rel.plt 57).
  lib/libvpud_vcodec.so: 191 = packed ANDROID_REL 37 (2 ABS32 + 35 GLOB_DAT) + 143 JUMP_SLOT + RELR 11.
  lib/libvcodecdrv.so: 2162 = packed 366 (133 ABS32 + 233 GLOB_DAT) + 1401 JUMP_SLOT + RELR 395.
  lib/libvcodec_utility.so: 498 = packed 128 (2 ABS32 + 126 GLOB_DAT) + 314 JUMP_SLOT + RELR 56.
  lib/libvcodec_oal.so: 178 = 118 RELATIVE + 29 GLOB_DAT + 31 JUMP_SLOT (plain REL).
  Evidence: llvm-readelf -r -W on each object (RELR expanded addresses decoded from the .relr.dyn raw words; llvm-readelf prints "contains N entries" and agrees).
[V] Imports: 529 undefined dynsym entries; 2593 defined names in the set; the difference leaves exactly 149 unique imported symbols. Of those, 2 are STT_OBJECT data imports (__stack_chk_guard, stderr) and must be provided by a data shim table or n2elf_link fails by design. __aeabi_unwind_cpp_pr0 appears as an undefined FUNC but has no dynamic relocation at all (only .ARM.exidx personality encoding), so the loader binds 146 function names to unresolved host-call slots for this set. Do not expect 149 "unresolved" at runtime; 149 is the unique import count.
[V] Android packed format per-item order is OFFSET DELTA first, then r_info; group header order is group_size, group_flags, then grouped INFO, grouped OFFSET_DELTA, grouped ADDEND. My first decoder had info first and failed on libvpud_vcodec.so (decoded type 156 where readelf says GLOB_DAT). Evidence: the five vendor streams decoded with the corrected order match every llvm-readelf expansion field for field (37/366/128 entries), and my hand-built unit test covers all group flag combinations.
[V] bionic ignores explicit addends on AArch32 (Elf32_Rel): HAS_ADDEND/GROUPED_BY_ADDEND are parsed but the in-place word is the addend. No vendor stream uses the addend flags.
[V] llvm-readelf 23.1.4 has no --raw-relr option (the task text mentions it). Use `llvm-readelf -r` (it already expands .relr.dyn to one address per line + "contains N entries") or decode the .relr.dyn section bytes; both agree on all four RELR objects. The RELR encodings in use: Android tags 0x6fffe000/1/3 on libvpud_vcodec/libvcodecdrv/utility, modern DT_RELR 36/35/37 emitted by lld 23 for --pack-dyn-relocs=relr.
